reuse_rule_outcome: 8 OF 8 LINES REUSED — under the soa-01 reuse test, applied line by line: a verified take may serve a settled line only where (a) the settled text is identical to the take's requested text AND (b) the line's re-derivation is on record. (a) is proven cryptographically, not asserted: for every line, sha256(settled line text) == the job result's requested_text_sha256, and the downloaded WAV master's sha256 == the hash recorded at synthesis (re-verified 2026-10-26 in this phase). (b) is phase 3's per-line account (consolidation §4): each settled line was independently re-derived against the architecture before the reuse was claimed. The takes come from this morning's redevelopment DRAFT job — synthesized from the owner's own definition before this branch existed; reusing them imports no part of the rejected first build (whose text shares zero lines with the settled text). ZERO new synthesis was needed; no Pelican job was submitted in this phase, and none is in flight.

trim_rule: silence-cluster-merge, the lane standard: ffmpeg silencedetect at -45 dB, min silence 0.25 s; clusters merged across gaps < 0.35 s; 50 ms pads kept at speech edges

fit.rule: window = trimmed duration + planned gap (phase-3 pause map); fit requires the gap to survive whole at atempo 1.0 with the standard's 0.15 s guard to spare
fit.outcome: all 8 lines fit at atempo 1.000 (no time-stretch anywhere); every planned gap (0.45–1.00 s) survives intact; zero overlap by construction: fitted_end[i] + gap[i] = start[i+1] exactly, per the locking rule in transcript/delivery.md. Total programme 52.251 s.

bed.source: files/short-wd02-prompt-v1-musiconly.mp4 (the piece's own music-only twin, sha256 b6b418d1278b23fada388e8a7e55479047d50c5baa90ea7c914f6f78b702a1a3, 45.84 s) — MUSIC-ASSET citation, recorded as such: the bed is a produced music asset, not a design decision of the first build; reusing it imports none of the old video's structure
